description: XTFrame preset symbol group Survey 2026 (Docs/design/55-survey-symbol-group.md). One symbol per <Name>.xt; every symbol draws only through the tokens of tokens.xts.
license: CC0-1.0 (see LICENSE): free for any use, including commercial, no attribution required.

symbols.name: MenuItem
symbols.description: Main-menu entry: a grime band slides in behind the label on hover, focus and selection; emits `pressed`.

symbols.name: Panel
symbols.description: Translucent settings panel: heading, one-line description, a rule and a body slot for rows.

symbols.name: SaveSlot
symbols.description: Load-game entry: chapter, location and timestamp with the grime band for hover and selection; Empty variant; emits `pressed`.

symbols.name: ChapterCard
symbols.description: Centred chapter title card: chapter number, title, a red rule and a place/date line; fades in and out.

symbols.name: LoadingIndicator
symbols.description: Loading block: a label that breathes, a hairline progress bar for `progress` 0-100 and a tip line.

symbols.name: PickupNotice
symbols.description: Pickup/journal notice: a cream mark, a small-caps heading and the item name; slides in on show, out on hide.

symbols.name: ConfirmDialog
symbols.description: Modal confirm: strong scrim, scratched dark panel with title, rule, body and an actions slot for key hints; Escape emits `cancel`.

symbols.name: SubtitleLine
symbols.description: Subtitle line on a soft scrim: small-caps speaker over a centred line; Narrator variant drops the speaker and italicises.

symbols.name: SettingsTab
symbols.description: Settings category tab with the grime band for hover and selection; emits `pressed`.

symbols.name: SliderRow
symbols.description: Settings row with a hairline slider and its numeric value; drag or nav keys change `value`.
triggers: drag.value: set(value, event.value | range(0, 1, min, max) | round)
nav.value: sound(ui_tick); if lt(0) emit(decrease) else emit(increase)

symbols.name: ToggleRow
symbols.description: Settings row with On/Off text and a pill switch bound to `on`; emits `toggled`.

symbols.name: CyclerRow
symbols.description: Settings row with a boxed `< value >` picker; arrows and Left/Right emit `prev`/`next`.

symbols.name: KeyBindRow
symbols.description: Settings row showing a bound key; `listening` swaps it for a pulsing prompt; click or Enter emits `rebind`.
triggers: port(listening): if eq(1) play(pulse, loop) else stop(pulse)

symbols.name: ActionRow
symbols.description: Settings row with a boxed action button (e.g. Play Test Sound); emits `pressed`.

symbols.name: ScreenShade
symbols.description: Full-bleed darkening over scene art: a vignette, a left fade for menus or a bottom fade for subtitles.

symbols.name: RainLayer
symbols.description: Tiled rain streaks falling in a seamless 0.5 s loop; Light or Heavy.

symbols.name: FilmGrain
symbols.description: Animated film grain overlay that jitters in a 0.5 s loop.

symbols.name: FogBank
symbols.description: Low fog bank tiled across the bottom of a scene; Low or High.

symbols.name: BloodEdge
symbols.description: Red damage edge whose opacity follows `level` (0-1); pulses at 0.6 and above.

symbols.name: TitleLockup
symbols.description: Game title set in live type with a thin red slash and a tracked subtitle; fades in on show.

symbols.name: KeyHint
symbols.description: Footer key hint: one or two keycaps and a label, optional divider before it; clickable, emits `pressed`.

symbols.name: VersionTag
symbols.description: Small build/version caption for a screen corner.

symbols.name: SiteCard
symbols.description: Right-aligned three-line site plaque (place, city, years) with a hairline rule.

symbols.name: ObjectiveBanner
symbols.description: Top-left objective block: a rule, the `Objective:` label and the current objective; replays a fade when it changes.

symbols.name: LocationClock
symbols.description: Top-right location name over a rule and a 24-hour clock.

symbols.name: VitalBar
symbols.description: HUD vital: line icon, small-caps label and a thin bar for `value` 0-100; turns red below 30; `hit` flashes it.

symbols.name: NoiseMeter
symbols.description: HUD noise meter: mic icon, label, a bar waveform and a level word, sage/amber/red for `level` 0/1/2.

symbols.name: InteractPrompt
symbols.description: Interaction prompt: keycap and action label on a soft scrim, shown by `visible`.

symbols.name: InventorySlot
symbols.description: Quick-slot cell with a number badge, a line-art item icon (Flashlight, Crowbar, Clipboard, Key or Empty) and a caption; `selected` frames it.

symbols.name: FocusDot
symbols.description: Minimal centre aim dot; `target` adds a ring for something interactable.
